source_work: Noah Webster, An American Dictionary of the English Language (1828)
rights_basis: The original 1828 dictionary text is public domain.
selection_method: Selected the next three high-use KJV words with exact-headword source pages after rejecting higher-ranked pages that did not expose an exact entry.
review_method: Verified each page heading and entry heading, preserved the displayed wording, normalized whitespace only, and excluded any page whose heading did not match the requested word.
guardrails: No base OCR entry was rewritten.
No neighboring-word or related-word page was accepted.
No definition wording was summarized, modernized, or invented.
